summary: This Form 6-K reports completion of an at-the-market equity offering by YY Group Holding Ltd. (NASD: YYGH) that raised $20M, and a 30-for-1 reverse share split effective June 23, 2026. The ATM was launched, paused, relaunched, and completed; proceeds will fund prior acquisitions and working capital. The reverse split reduced outstanding shares from ~96 million to ~3.2 million. No special situation is present: the capital raise is routine and the reverse split is a mechanical adjustment, not a strategic event. The filing lacks terms typical of acquisitions, divestitures, or other special-situation categories.
